policy: Internal independent implementation, not third-party certification. Recompute frozen study from currently cached cleaned candles; compare counts/rates only if dataset hash matches. Estimate marginal rate difference with 28-calendar-day clustered influence standard error and normal Bonferroni interval across all 192 combinations; approximate and not guaranteed valid under dependence across clusters. Contrast with original within-week estimand. Historical split is exploratory, not untouched holdout. For direction hypotheses only, choose long or short from early conditional open-to-close returns, then measure later conditional open-to-close returns net of hypothetical fixed round-trip costs and compare same-direction unconditional returns; no fills, slippage model, roll-adjusted data or trade execution claim. No automatic promotion.
